query:
SELECT m.id FROM media m WHERE m."libraryId" = $1 AND m.type = $2 AND m."folderName" = ''
               AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_files f WHERE f."mediaId" = m.id
                           AND f."folderId" = ANY($4) AND f."relativePath" = ANY($3))
               ORDER BY m.id LIMIT 1
